name: Sustainability Sci & Prac (MS)

rules.name: SUST Program Academic Policies
rules.notes:
The following are required of all MS students:

• A minimum of 45 units of coursework.

• At least 34 units of coursework must be at the 200 level or above.

• All coursework must be at the 100 level or above.

• At least 25 of the 45 units must be designated as “science” units.

• All courses must be taken for a letter grade if a letter grade is offered.

• At least three elective courses must be taken for three or more units.

• A cumulative GPA of 3.4 or higher must be maintained throughout the program.

• A minimum GPA of 3.4 is required to graduate.

rules.name: Understanding Earth Systems: Biophysical Interactions Path 1 or Path 2
rules.notes: Students who have not completed EARTHSYS 10: Introduction to Earth Systems must take a Path 1 course. Students who have completed EARTHSYS 10 may choose between Path 1 or Path 2.

children.name: Path 1
children.notes: Path 1 is required for all students who have not completed EARTHSYS 10.

children.name: Path 2
children.notes: Path 2: Students who have completed EARTHSYS 10 may take one of these biophysical science courses as an alternative to SUST 215 or EARTHSYS 217. The courses must be taken at the 200+ level. Some courses have prerequisites.

rules.name: Decision Making and Behavior
rules.notes: Choose two. Courses must be taken for at least three units to fulfill this requirement.

rules.name: Design and Innovation
rules.notes: Choose two. Courses must be taken for at least three units to fulfill this requirement. The Design and Innovation course list is subject to change quarterly.

rules.name: Additional Requirements for M.S. Candidates
rules.notes: Units from the Mathematics and Statistics courses do not count toward the 45 units required for the SUST master’s degree. Completing these requirements prior to the master’s program is recommended.

rules.name: Elective Courses (three of 3+ units from the sciences, arts or blended lists)
rules.desc: Complete additional units from any of the following three lists to satisfy SUST unit requirements
rules.notes:
SUST Program Policies for Elective Courses

• At least three elective courses for the master’s program must be taken for three or more units.

• Elective courses must be selected from the SUST program’s pre-approved list.

• Students who would like to take an elective course not on the program’s approved electives list may request approval for other elective courses via the program’s course petition process. Petitions must be submitted no later than Week 2 of the quarter in which the student wishes to take the course.

• Students must take most (and ideally all) of their elective courses during their time in the SUST coterm. At the program’s discretion, a limited number of elective units may be considered for transfer from the undergraduate career to the SUST graduate career.

reviewNotes: You take the SUST core, an Earth Systems social interactions course, a biophysical course (Path 1, or Path 2 if you completed EARTHSYS 10), two Decision Making and two Design and Innovation courses and three electives (each of 3+ units), for 45 units, all letter graded where offered. As an MS candidate you also take one mathematics course (CME 100 or MATH 51) and one statistics course, ideally before the program; their units do not count toward the 45. At least 34 units must be at the 200 level and none below the 100 level. Your 3.4 GPA and the 25 science-designated units (blended courses count half) are checked by hand, as are petitioned electives.
